**Audit result**
Read-only static audit only (rg/sed/cat/stat/shasum/ls; no Python/Node run; FIFO never touched; no file modified). Path shorthand below: `checks/…`, `tools/…`, `evidence/…` are under `harness-development/line-v3-live-e2e-20261010/continuations/scope-recovery-05/recovery-02/`. In-scope hashes verified identical at audit start and end: `checks/run_command.py` `f25b192f…`, `checks/test_run_command.py` `157a37c1…`, `check-specs.json` `5bd52c11…`. Note: `tools/gate_receipts.py` was edited by concurrent work during the audit window (now `18fafe68…`); findings below cite that current revision.

**BLOCKER**
- None found in the three audited files. `check-specs-freeze.json` absence right now is by design (`check-specs.json:191-194`, `written_when=AFTER_G_BASELINE_PASS_BEFORE_HOST_PREFLIGHT`); without a correct freeze, `runner-preflight-01`/`runner-selftest-01`/`G_RUNNER` fail closed.

**B1 — freeze contract (what `--preflight` validates)**
- Single global freeze, not per-check: `build_expected_bindings` walks **all 5 checks'** `source_hashes` (`checks/run_command.py:167-180`), excludes the freeze key itself (`:171`), resolves each key via `_resolve_rel` — RUNROOT copy only if no ROOT-root copy (`:157-164`), refuses `SOURCE_NOT_RESOLVED` on 0 or 2 candidates (`:175`), and refuses `FIXED_SOURCE_MISMATCH` when a non-null spec hash ≠ disk (`:177-178`).
- `verify_specs_and_freeze` requires exactly (`checks/run_command.py:183-201`): `task_id == "TASK-20261011-line-baseline-recovery-02"`, `run_rel == "harness-development/…/recovery-02"`, `self_reference.excluded_relative_path == "<RUNREL>/check-specs-freeze.json"` (`:193-195`), and `resolved_source_hashes == expected` by exact dict equality → `FREEZE_BINDINGS_MISMATCH:missing/extra/mismatched` (`:196-200`). `self_reference.rule`/`note` are **not** read/required — only `excluded_relative_path`.
- Refusal channels: missing/unreadable freeze, `SOURCE_NOT_RESOLVED`, `FIXED_SOURCE_MISMATCH` raise inside `build_expected_bindings` → caught → `{"status":"PREFLIGHT_REFUSED"/"REFUSED","errors":["SPECS_UNREADABLE:…"]}` exit 2 (`:435-446`, `:448-460`); identity/self-rule/binding problems → `PREFLIGHT_REFUSED`/`REFUSED` exit 2 (`:440-447`, `:448-460`); runtime problems `RUNTIME_MISSING`/`RUNTIME_MISMATCH` same channels (`:204-216`); wrong tool location/symlink ancestor `REFUSED` exit 2 before specs read (`:142-154`, `:430-434`). Success: `PREFLIGHT_OK` JSON, exit 0, `writes:0`, `child_started:false` (`:233-255`, `:449`).
- Per-check key contributions: baseline-selftest-02 → `{RUNREL}/tools/inventory.py`, `{RUNREL}/checks/test_inventory.py`, `{RUNREL}/checks/compare_inventories.py` (`check-specs.json:50-54`); runner-preflight-01 → `{RUNREL}/checks/run_command.py`, `{RUNREL}/check-specs.json` (freeze key excluded) (`:80-84`); runner-selftest-01 adds `{RUNREL}/checks/test_run_command.py` (`:111-116`); node-adapter-syntax-02 → `scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs` (fixed `bf83dd93…`, `:143-145`); node-adapter-tests-01 → adapter, `tests/test_cua_adapter.mjs` (fixed `0bb0d996…`), `{RUNREL}/checks/test_capture_regression.mjs` (null, `:173-177`).

**B2 — who writes the freeze**
- Fully host-authored: `run_command.py` has no freeze-emitting mode; its only writes are the three exclusive files per check (`checks/run_command.py:382-383`, `:423`); `--preflight` writes nothing (`:252`). Host must create `…/recovery-02/check-specs-freeze.json` directly, after G_BASELINE PASS, before `runner-preflight-01` (write timing also matters for baseline bookkeeping: it must not exist at b1/b2).
- Required content (values must be recomputed at write time; below are audit-time values):

**B3 — argument/exit/spawn contracts**
- Usage shapes: exact `tool --preflight` (len==2) or `tool CHECK_ID -- CMD [ARG…]` (len≥4, argv[2]=="--"); anything else → `raise SystemExit("usage: …")` exit 1, plain-text stderr, no JSON (`checks/run_command.py:435`, `:448`, `:464`).
- Run refusals exit 2 with JSON `{"status":"REFUSED","check_id":…,"errors":[…]}`: `UNKNOWN_CHECK_ID`, `ARGV_NOT_FROZEN`, `RUNTIME_NOT_FIXED` (only for `launcher=="VERIFIED_RUNROOT_RUNNER"`), `ID_COLLISION` on any of the 3 outputs, checked before launch (`:325-348`). Pass 0 / child-fail 1, both writing the 3 evidence files (`:384`, `:424-427`).
- Statuses: only `PASS`/`FAIL`; timeout is a boolean field (`"timeout": true`), not a TIMEOUT status (`:384`, `:398`). Receipts: `evidence/<check_id>.stdout|.stderr|.receipt.json`, exclusive O_EXCL + anchored dirfd + fsync + readback, never rewritten; `automatic_retry:false` in receipt (`:382-383`, `:419`, `:423`).
- Spawn: cwd fixed to `/Users/hsiaojohnny/Documents/ChatGPT/Line_backup`, env = os.environ + spec `environment` (PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE/TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP), stdin DEVNULL, pipes, `shell=False`, `start_new_session=True`; timeout from spec (60 s); 1 MiB cap — note both streams are capped by the single `stdout_limit_bytes` value; `stderr_limit_bytes` is never read (RISK-NOTE, equal today so no divergence) (`:349-350`, `:355-366`). Timeout/cap → whole process group SIGKILL + reap, partial streams kept, FAIL (`:295-311`, `:366-378`).
- Wrong cwd only matters for relative `argv[0]` (→ `WRONG_LOCATION`); the runner does not assert its own cwd and always launches children in ROOT (`:142-149`, `:54`). `requires` is not enforced by the runner (host/order only).

**B4 — test coverage vs contract**
- Covered: preflight happy path + no-write assertion (`checks/test_run_command.py:117-131`), WRONG_LOCATION/SYMLINK/UNKNOWN/ARGV refusals + no evidence on refusal (`:147-184`), ID collision + no launch + second run (`:186-243`), PASS receipt/stream readback/receipt-on-disk (`:206-231`), FAIL exit 3 (`:245-257`), timeout kill/reap/grandchild (`:259-298`), stdout cap (`:300-318`), fixed child cwd (`:320-338`).
- Not covered (all NOTE): every freeze negative path (`FREEZE_IDENTITY/SELF_RULE/BINDINGS` mismatch, missing freeze → `SPECS_UNREADABLE`), `FIXED_SOURCE_MISMATCH`/`SOURCE_NOT_RESOLVED`, `RUNTIME_MISSING`/`RUNTIME_MISMATCH`, `RUNTIME_NOT_FIXED` (fixtures always use `launcher:"FIXTURE"`, `:86`), `MISSING_DIR`, usage-error SystemExit (`:464`), CLI success/fail end-to-end (in-process only), receipt `product_hashes`/`source_hashes`/`environment_overrides` content, stderr-side cap, launch-failure traceback path (`Popen` at `:355` is unguarded; a spawn failure would exit 1 with traceback and no receipt).
- Depends on not-yet-present file: `check-specs-freeze.json` (needed by the in-process preflight case, `:121-125`, and by the official runner checks). All other dependencies exist and hash-match, including both executables (`python3.13` `34af8eed…`/52640 B, `node` `1ef99ea2…`/50320 B, matching `check-specs.json:12-27`).

**B5 — check-specs vs runner/gate expectations**
- Consistent: all 5 entries' `argv`/`launcher`/`evidence_stem` (= `EVIDENCE/<check_id>`, which the runner actually writes) / 60 s timeout / 1 MiB limits / env / dependency chain (`check-specs.json:32-36,61-65,91-98,123-130,152-160`). Fixed adapter/test hashes equal disk and gate `EXP` (`tools/gate_receipts.py:440-442`, `:491-494`).
- NOTE: `runner_allowed_check_ids` is only reported (`checks/run_command.py:232`), never enforced — the docstring claim at `:9-10` is inaccurate; a HOST-launcher id passed to the runner would actually launch. Suggested fix (optional): add `if check_id not in specs.get("runner_allowed_check_ids", []): refusal.append(...)`, or correct the docstring. Low risk: host launches only the two node ids.
- NOTE: spec fields `requires`, `evidence_stem`, `product_attempt`, `cwd`, `automatic_retry`, `first_failure` are unread by the runner; consistent values, host-side enforcement only.
- NOTE: runner receipt `source_hashes["check-specs-freeze.json"]` is deliberately `null` (spec key vs exclusion at `:171`); `g_adapter` does not read it (`tools/gate_receipts.py:488-499`).
- The earlier vacuous `preflight_before_node_launch` check in `gate_receipts.py` is fixed in the current revision (now checks `.receipt.json/.stdout/.stderr` for both node stems, `tools/gate_receipts.py:450-455`).

**RISK — host-side operational guards**
- Do **not** pre-create or shell-redirect into `evidence/node-adapter-{syntax-02,tests-01}.{stdout,stderr,receipt.json}`: any pre-existing file causes `ID_COLLISION` refusal before launch (`checks/run_command.py:341-347`). The runner writes them itself; capture the runner's own summary stdout elsewhere (not in those paths). `g_adapter` requires syntax `.stdout` == 0 bytes (`tools/gate_receipts.py:495-496`).
- `runner-preflight-01`/`runner-selftest-01` host receipts must show `exit_code==0`, `timeout` not true, and **empty stderr**; preflight stdout must parse to `status=="PREFLIGHT_OK"`, selftest stdout to `pass:true`, all cases ok, `run_command_sha256` matching disk (`tools/gate_receipts.py:288-304`, `:446-463`).
- Do not create duplicate copies of any mapped source at both ROOT-root and RUNROOT paths (would make `_resolve_rel` fail closed). Recommended: run one scratch `python -B checks/run_command.py --preflight` (writes nothing) after writing the freeze to catch a miskeyed freeze before the official at-most-once host dispatch.

**B6 — node checks vs product files (all PASS)**
- `scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs` exists 39953 B sha `bf83dd93…` ✓; `tests/test_cua_adapter.mjs` 18529 B sha `0bb0d996…` ✓; `checks/test_capture_regression.mjs` 10808 B sha `dc45d7e7…` (= expected) ✓.
- Imports/exports resolve statically: `tests/test_cua_adapter.mjs:5-6` imports `../scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs`; `checks/test_capture_regression.mjs:9-10` imports `../../../../../../scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs` (resolves to ROOT/scripts); required exports `normalizeScreenshotBytes`, `createAlbumSupportCallbacks`, `createHostedSession`, `createNavigationObserver` exist (`scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs:16,45,77,484`). `node --check` from cwd=ROOT and `node --test` with both file paths are consistent with the frozen argv.
